_doc: Scenario fields: id, title, text, category (social/school/training/health/work/media/family/money/team/romance/community/career), stages [high_school/juco/college/pro], when [season/bye/offseason] (default season+bye), weeks [min,max], seasons [min,max] (season within the stage), weight (default 1), once, cooldown (weeks), requires {min:{stat:n}, max:{stat:n}, traits:[all], any_traits:[one of], flags:[], not_flags:[], any_of:[requires,...]}, beat {season_in_stage, week} (guaranteed story beat, shown once), follow_up_only (only reachable as a follow-up), gate (label shown for trait-gated scenarios). Choices (2-4): label, result, stats {life/football/personality:{stat:change}} (projected on screen through the stat rules), modifiers [game-day modifier ids, at least one], requires (same as above; locked choices are shown with the requirement), set_flags {name: value}, follow_up {id, weeks}, recruiting / draft / retention (points) and grades (GPA points, 0-4 scale). Requirements min/max also take recruiting, draft, retention, gpa and age. Bye/offseason modifiers carry into the next game. Content rule: general/teen audience - no drugs or alcohol for the player, no sexual content, no graphic violence; peer pressure can always be declined (declining may cost Social). See data/career/content_rules.json.

scenarios.title: Friday Night Party
scenarios.text: A senior on the team is throwing a party the night before the game. Half the roster is going and they want you there.

choices.label: Go and stay late
choices.result: Great night with the team. Rough morning.

choices.label: Stop by for an hour
choices.result: You show your face, laugh a little, and head home at a decent hour.

choices.label: Stay home and sleep
choices.result: Lights out by ten. A few teammates give you grief about it.

scenarios.title: Exam or Film?
scenarios.text: Big chemistry exam Thursday. Coach also scheduled a special-teams film session the same night.

choices.label: Study for the exam
choices.result: You ace it. Coach notices you weren't at film.

choices.label: Go to film
choices.result: You learn how this week's stadium swirls the wind.

choices.label: Try to do both
choices.result: Film, then studying past midnight.

choices.label: Breeze through both
choices.result: You know the film already and the chemistry clicks.

scenarios.title: A Ride Home
scenarios.text: Your best friend's car died across town at 11 p.m. They're asking you to come get them.

choices.label: Go get them
choices.result: They won't forget it. You get to bed late.

choices.label: Help them find another ride
choices.result: A few calls later they're sorted, and so are you.

choices.label: Say you can't
choices.result: Things are a little cold at lunch the next day.

scenarios.title: Coach Wants Extra Reps
scenarios.text: The special teams coach asks if you'll stay after practice for 50 extra kicks.

choices.label: Stay for all 50
choices.result: Your plant foot is finally landing in the same spot.

choices.label: Do 20 and save the leg
choices.result: Quality over quantity.

choices.label: Head home
choices.result: Coach shrugs. You get a free evening.

scenarios.title: Locker Room Beef
scenarios.text: A linebacker keeps calling you 'the soccer kid' in front of everyone.

choices.label: Talk to him one-on-one
choices.result: Turns out he's nervous about his own spot. You squash it.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.result: It keeps nagging at you all week.

choices.label: Fire back in front of the team
choices.result: Everyone laughs. He doesn't.

choices.label: Rally the whole unit
choices.result: As captain, you turn it into a team bonding drill. Problem solved.

scenarios.title: He's Got Your Back
scenarios.text: The linebacker you talked to stands up for you when a rival player mouths off at practice.

choices.label: Thank him in front of the team
choices.result: The locker room notices. So does the coach.

choices.label: Buy him a smoothie after practice
choices.result: A real friendship starts here.

scenarios.title: Tight Hamstring
scenarios.text: Your plant-side hamstring grabbed on a deep kick in practice.

choices.label: Ice, stretch and rest it
choices.result: It loosens up by Friday.

choices.label: Kick through it
choices.result: You don't miss a rep, but you feel it.

choices.label: See the athletic trainer
choices.result: Taped up and cleared, with a stretching plan.

scenarios.title: Extra Shift
scenarios.text: The pizza place where you work is short-staffed Thursday night and asks you to close.

choices.label: Take the shift
choices.result: Good tips, late night, sore feet.

choices.label: Work a short shift
choices.result: You help with the rush and leave at eight.

choices.label: Turn it down
choices.result: Your manager isn't thrilled, but you're rested.

scenarios.title: Date Night
scenarios.text: Someone you like asked if you want to get dinner and see a movie Thursday.

choices.label: Dinner and a movie
choices.result: A great night. You float into practice Friday.

choices.label: Invite them to the game instead
choices.result: They'll be in the stands. No pressure.

choices.label: Reschedule for after the season
choices.result: They say okay. It's a little awkward.

scenarios.title: Gone Viral
scenarios.text: Your behind-the-back trick-shot field goal video is all over social media. Your phone won't stop buzzing.

choices.label: Post more trick shots
choices.result: Followers pour in. So does attention.

choices.label: Say thanks, then go quiet
choices.result: A classy post and back to work.

choices.label: Turn notifications off
choices.result: Peace and quiet.

scenarios.title: The Comments Section
scenarios.text: With the views came the comments. Some of them are rough.

choices.label: Ignore them and keep kicking
choices.result: Their opinion doesn't make the kick.

choices.label: Clap back
choices.result: It feels good for about five minutes.

choices.label: Talk it through with your coach
choices.result: Coach has seen it all before.

scenarios.title: Kicker Battle
scenarios.text: A transfer kicker shows up with a big leg, and coach says the job is open this week.

choices.label: Win it in practice
choices.result: You outkick him from 45. The job is yours.

choices.label: Help him learn the system
choices.result: Coach likes what he sees from you.

choices.label: Stress about it all week
choices.result: You keep checking the depth chart.

scenarios.title: Grandparents in Town
scenarios.text: Your grandparents are visiting for the game and want a big family dinner the night before.

choices.label: Big family dinner
choices.result: Stories, laughs and way too much pasta.

choices.label: Quick dinner, early bed
choices.result: You get the best of both.

choices.label: Show Grandpa your game film
choices.result: He points out your plant foot. He's right.

scenarios.title: Scholarship Camp
scenarios.text: College coaches run a summer kicking camp. It's your best chance to get noticed before senior year.

choices.label: The big showcase camp
choices.result: You hit from 50 in front of a dozen coaches.

choices.label: A smaller regional camp
choices.result: More reps, less spotlight.

choices.label: Skip it and work a summer job
choices.result: Money in the bank. No one saw you kick.

scenarios.title: A Coach in the Stands
scenarios.text: A college special teams coach is at practice this week to watch you kick.

choices.label: Show off the big leg in warmups
choices.result: He writes something down after your 55-yarder.

choices.label: Stick to your routine
choices.result: Calm and consistent. That's what he came to see.

choices.label: Introduce yourself after practice
choices.result: A firm handshake and a good conversation.

scenarios.title: Regional Showcase
scenarios.text: A regional kicking showcase is ranking the best high school kickers in the state.

choices.label: Compete for a top ranking
choices.result: You place in the top ten. Coaches take notes.

choices.label: Go mainly to film your kicks
choices.result: Great footage for your highlight tape.

choices.label: Skip it and enjoy the break
choices.result: A relaxed few weeks.

scenarios.title: Highlight Tape
scenarios.text: College coaches keep asking for your highlight tape. You don't have one yet.

choices.label: Pay a video editor
choices.result: A slick tape with slow motion and music.

choices.label: Cut it together yourself
choices.result: Late nights, but it's good, and it's yours.

choices.label: Let your stats speak
choices.result: You stay out of it.

scenarios.title: A Recruiter Calls
scenarios.text: A college special teams coach calls your house after practice.

choices.label: Sell yourself
choices.result: He likes your confidence.

choices.label: Ask about academics and fit
choices.result: A real conversation about your future.

choices.label: Let your coach handle it
choices.result: Your coach talks you up.

scenarios.title: Official Visit
scenarios.text: A college invites you for an official weekend visit: tour, team dinner, a game in their stadium.

choices.label: Go on the visit
choices.result: The stadium gives you chills.

choices.label: Take the video tour instead
choices.result: Convenient, if a little flat.

choices.label: Stay focused on your season
choices.result: The coach respects it. Mostly.

scenarios.title: Academic Warning
scenarios.text: Your guidance counselor says your grades could cost you college offers.

choices.label: Get a tutor
choices.result: Two sessions a week. It's working.

choices.label: Study group with teammates
choices.result: Misery loves company, and flashcards.

choices.label: You'll figure it out
choices.result: You don't.
